mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (operator_id, operator_name, module, action, target_id, detail, ip, success) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{module}, #{action}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{ip}, #{success})

where.if: AND (operator_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR action ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR detail ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
